messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: high p95 latency observed for /v1/generate (text-generation) in us-west-2. Count: 18 alerts in 3m. Severity: P1. thread_ts=1785123456
Priya K: ack — I'm on it. Pulling traces now.
Samir G: I see a big queue backlog on the transformer workers, qdepth ~6000, tokens/sec down 40%. Possible KV cache thrash after the deploy.
Jess L (SRE): @Priya can you confirm if there's a deploy in the last 15m? deploy-bot: Deploy completed by @samir at 1785123300 to service=runtime-v2, image=redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-rc3
Priya K: confirmed deploy happened ~3m before alerts. Rolling back is an option but want to try targeted mitigations first.
Samir G: Repro on staging shows similar p95 bump when running long-sequence prompts + batching window default (50ms). Hypothesis: batching+kv eviction thrash on new kernel.
Jess L (SRE): Mitigation plan: 1) reduce batching window to 10ms 2) enable model-fallback to quantized-small for overflow traffic 3) scale out worker pool + warm new instances. I'll run the autoscale command now.
Jess L (SRE): running:
```
# increase replica count for runtime pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/runtime-workers --replicas=18
# reduce batching window
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/runtime-workers BATCH_WINDOW_MS=10
```
Priya K: Enabled model-fallback rule on routing policy to send 15% of requests to quantized-2x variant and prioritized latency-tier traffic to dedicated pool.
Samir G: Warmed 6 new workers, KV cache warming in progress. CPU steady, but GPU memory pressure was high -> freed by fallback. p95 trending down from 1200ms -> 650ms (last 2m).
Alex M (Product): Heads-up for customers: do we have visibility across tenants? Any specific enterprise customers impacted?
Lara (Support): Checking open tickets — nothing escalated yet but a few users reported "responses taking much longer than usual" via support form. No data loss reported.
Priya K: Draft status page (please edit):
```
Incident detected: Degraded latency for text-generation API in us-west-2. Impact: elevated response times (p95) for some requests. Mitigation: routing and scaling actions in progress. Customer impact: degraded performance, no errors or data loss observed. ETA: 30-45 minutes for full recovery. Updates every 15 minutes.```
Samir G: Suggest add: "If you require strict latency guarantees, temporarily pin to dedicated endpoints or reduce max_tokens in requests"
Jess L (SRE): Quick customer notification template: 
```
Subject: Service update — degraded performance for text-generation (us-west-2)
Body: We're investigating elevated latency affecting text-generation in us-west-2. Our engineers are actively mitigating; fallback routing and autoscaling have been applied. No data loss. Expected restoration within ~30-45m. We'll post follow-ups here: <status page link>
```
Priya K: Patching note: we will roll back the runtime image if metrics don't stabilize to p95 < 300ms in 30m. If rollback, will coordinate maintenance window and follow up.
Incident Bot: Update: mitigation actions applied by @Jess L and @Priya K at 1785123490. Alerts suppressed while stabilizing.
Samir G: Current metrics: p50=85ms p95=420ms error-rate=0.12%. Throughput recovered to ~85% baseline.
Alex M (Product): Good — prepare a concise customer bulletin for high-touch accounts (include steps they can take client-side). @Lara please queue outreach if we hit 45m without full recovery.
Lara (Support): Will stand by. Drafting messages for top-5 accounts and escalating to Account Execs.
On-call Handoff Bot: Next on-call @Samir G scheduled in 30m. Handoff checklist: summarize current mitigations, open actions: watch p95, decide rollback by +30m, confirm no data loss.
Priya K: Passing off to @Samir G — I'll remain available for escalation. Postmortem owner: @Priya K. Root-cause hypothesis: interaction between new runtime kernels + batching defaults causing KV cache churn under long-seq workloads.
Samir G: Acknowledged. I'll continue monitoring and will post a full timeline + attempted mitigations to this thread.
Incident Bot: Incident status: Mitigated -> Degraded (partial recovery). Next update in 15 minutes. :white_check_mark:
